#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
source /workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/build.env
cd /workspace/Nexora-scene-ui-composition
out=/workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/authoring/scene-ui-compositor/editor-tag-rejection
trap 'printf "%s\n" "$?" > "$out/all-gates.exit"' EXIT
printf '%s\n' running > "$out/all-gates.exit"
run_gate() {
  local label="$1"
  shift
  printf '%s\n' "$label" > "$out/current-gate"
  local result=0
  "$@" > "$out/$label.log" 2>&1 || result=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$result" > "$out/$label.exit"
  return "$result"
}
run_gate final-development-configure cmake --preset linux-development -DNEXORA_BUILD_SHOWCASE=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_EDITOR_GRAPHICAL_SHELL=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_SLANG=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_ZIG_GAMEPLAY=ON -DNEXORA_ZIG_EXECUTABLE=/workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/tools/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ziglang/zig -DNEXORA_BUILD_PROJECT_PLAYER=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLAYER_NATIVE=ON
run_gate final-development-build cmake --build --preset linux-development
run_gate final-development-test ctest --preset linux-development --output-on-failure
run_gate shipping-configure cmake --preset linux-shipping -DNEXORA_SHIPPING_PROFILE=Full -DNEXORA_BUILD_SHOWCASE=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_2D=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_EDITOR_SDK=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_SLANG=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_ZIG_GAMEPLAY=ON -DNEXORA_ZIG_EXECUTABLE=/workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/tools/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ziglang/zig -DNEXORA_BUILD_PROJECT_PLAYER=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLAYER_NATIVE=ON -DCMAKE_PROJECT_Nexora_INCLUDE=/workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/authoring/scene-ui-compositor/shipping-consumer.cmake
run_gate shipping-build cmake --build --preset linux-shipping
run_gate shipping-native python3 Tests/Showcase/LinuxVulkanSceneAcceptance.py --native-test /workspace/Nexora-scene-ui-composition/build/linux-shipping/NexoraSceneUiShippingAcceptance --evidence-dir /workspace/Nexora-scene-ui-composition/build/linux-shipping/artifacts/scene-ui-vulkan
run_gate monolithic-configure cmake --preset linux-development -B build/scene-ui-monolithic -DNEXORA_LINK_MODE=Monolithic -DNEXORA_ENABLE_2D=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_EDITOR_GRAPHICAL_SHELL=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_SLANG=OFF -DNEXORA_ENABLE_ZIG_GAMEPLAY=OFF
run_gate monolithic-build cmake --build build/scene-ui-monolithic --target NexoraSceneUiCompositionTests NexoraSceneViewAdmissionTests NexoraWindowPresentationTests NexoraGameplayGenerationTests NexoraGameTwoDPreviewTests
run_gate monolithic-test ctest --test-dir build/scene-ui-monolithic -R '^window_presentation\.(scene_ui_composition|scene_view_admission|contracts)$|^twod\.gameplay_generation$|^editor\.game_twod_preview$' --output-on-failure
run_gate feature-off-configure cmake --preset linux-development -B build/scene-ui-feature-off -DNEXORA_ENABLE_2D=OFF -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DNEXORA_ENABLE_EDITOR_GRAPHICAL_SHELL=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_SLANG=OFF -DNEXORA_ENABLE_ZIG_GAMEPLAY=OFF -DNEXORA_BUILD_PROJECT_PLAYER=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLAYER_NATIVE=ON
run_gate feature-off-build cmake --build build/scene-ui-feature-off --target NexoraEditor NexoraProjectPlayer
printf '%s\n' complete > "$out/current-gate"
